**Established rule**: Field-group comment headers organize inherited fields hierarchically by interface origin. Each interface/type lists **all implemented interface levels separately** as section headers (e.g., `# Node`, `# Entity`, `# RichStrongEntity`), then its own fields under `# TypeName`.

**Example (good pattern)**:
- [Artifact (L82-103)](semio/graphql/target.schema.graphql#L82-L103): `# Node` → `# StrongEntity` → `# RichStrongEntity` → `# Artifact`
- [Document (L105-126)](semio/graphql/target.schema.graphql#L105-L126): `# StrongEntity` → `# Artifact` → `# Document` (skips earlier ancestors shared via parent)

---

| Definition | Line | Issue | Severity |
|-----------|------|-------|----------|
